> Family archive: memoirs, photographs, and documents about Tatyana Timofeevna
> Krivosheina (1926–2021), her parents (Samsonov), husband Aleksandr Dmitrievich
> Krivoshein («Sasha», 1926–1988), kin, wartime letters, places and events.
> Bilingual RU/EN. Sources over speculation; living people protected.

> Семейный архив: мемуары, фото и документы о Кривошеиной Татьяне Тимофеевне
> (1926–2021), родителях Самсоновых, муже Кривошеине Александре Дмитриевиче
> («Саша», 1926–1988), роде, фронтовых письмах, местах и событиях. RU/EN.

## Identity canon (critical)

- Tatyana Timofeevna Krivosheina — notebook author; center of the archive
  RU: https://сжс.рф/lyudi/tatyana-timofeevna-krivosheina/
  EN: https://сжс.рф/en/people/tatyana-timofeevna-krivosheina/
- Husband «Саша» / Sasha = Aleksandr Dmitrievich Krivoshein (1926–1988)
  RU: https://сжс.рф/lyudi/aleksandr-krivoshein/
  EN: https://сжс.рф/en/people/aleksandr-krivoshein/
- Father-in-law Dmitry Aleksandrovich Krivoshein (1905–1979) — different person
  RU: https://сжс.рф/roditeli/krivoshein-dmitriy-aleksandrovich/
- Brother Tyoma / Timosha = Timofey Timofeevich Samsonov (not father Timofey Petrovich)
  RU: https://сжс.рф/lyudi/timofey-timofeevich-samsonov/
- Front letter 107 «Саша целует» (1944) is NOT the husband
